The user wants to know the expected ticket price for a flight from the first airport in the system list to the second airport, on 2024-11-15, economy class. We need to get the list of all airports, then pick the first two. Then we need to get flight cost. So we need to call list_all_airports, then get_flight_cost. We'll do it step by step.

We have no prior context about the user's identity or authentication. But the question is just to provide expected ticket price; we can call get_flight_cost without authentication? The function signature doesn't require auth. So we can call get_flight_cost directly. But we need the airport codes. So first call list_all_airports.
